title: Two speakers – English (Male Doctor, Female Patient)

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning. Please come in and take a seat. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Good morning, doctor. I have been having severe headaches and dizziness for the past four days.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I see. Does the headache stay on one side of your head, or does it feel like pressure all over?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: It feels like constant pressure around my forehead and temples, especially in the late afternoon.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Have you noticed any nausea, sensitivity to bright lights, or blurring in your vision?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, bright screen lights at work make it worse, but thankfully I have not vomited.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Understood. How has your sleep and water intake been over this past week?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My sleep has been quite irregular because of project deadlines, maybe only five hours a night, and I drink too much coffee.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alright. Let me check your blood pressure and examine your eyes first. Please relax your arm.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your blood pressure is slightly elevated at one hundred and thirty-five over eighty-eight.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is that dangerous, doctor? Should I be worried?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It is mildly elevated, likely triggered by sleep deprivation, stress, and caffeine. I will prescribe a mild pain reliever and advise you to rest.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Do I need to undergo an MRI or any blood investigations right away?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not immediately. Let us monitor your symptoms for one week. Please drink plenty of water, reduce screen time, and get at least seven hours of sleep.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you very much, doctor. I will follow your advice and see you next Monday.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You are welcome. Take care, and feel free to return sooner if the headache worsens.
